title: 芭蕾舞演员的职业生涯
desc: 芭蕾舞演员的职业生涯

paragraphs.en: Julie Kent, formerly a principal dancer with the American Ballet Theatre, recalls her last role as Juliet after announcing in 2015 she would no longer perform on stage.
paragraphs.zh: 朱莉·肯特曾是美国芭蕾舞剧院的首席舞者，她回忆起自己在2015年宣布不再登台表演后出演的最后一个角色——朱丽叶。

paragraphs.en: Thousands came to see the last performance at New York's Lincoln Center.
paragraphs.zh: 数千人前来观看在纽约林肯中心的最后一场演出。

paragraphs.en: It was the most heartbreaking and beautiful experience that I had to date.
paragraphs.zh: 这是我到目前为止经历过的最令人心碎却又最美好的体验。

paragraphs.en: It was a huge sense of loss of life that I had known for three decades.
paragraphs.zh: 在我芭蕾舞事业的三十年历程中，这件事给我带来了巨大的失落感。

paragraphs.en: American Ballet Theater is considered to be one of the best dance companies in the country.
paragraphs.zh: 美国芭蕾舞剧院被认为是美国最好的舞蹈团之一。

paragraphs.en: Julie Kent has been part of it longer than anyone else, 29 years, and 23 of those 29 years, she was a prima ballerina.
paragraphs.zh: 朱莉·肯特参与其中的时间比任何人都长，有29年，在这29年里，有23年她都是首席芭蕾舞演员。

paragraphs.en: But despite a live in the stage as a dancer, Kent came back to it, if only in a slightly different role.
paragraphs.zh: 但尽管肯特曾以舞者的身份活跃于舞台，她还是回到了这个领域，即便只是扮演一个略有不同的角色。

paragraphs.en: In 2016, she came back to DC where she grew up and where she first fell in love with ballet.
paragraphs.zh: 2016年，她回到了华盛顿特区，那里是她长大的地方，也是她最初爱上芭蕾舞的地方。

paragraphs.en: She became artistic director of the Washington Ballet in the nation's capital.
paragraphs.zh: 她成为了美国首都华盛顿芭蕾舞团的艺术总监。

paragraphs.en: And her husband Victor Barbie, formerly the American Ballet Theatre principal dancer, helped her in this job as the associate artistic director.
paragraphs.zh: 她的丈夫维克多·芭比曾是美国芭蕾舞剧院的首席舞者，作为副艺术总监协助她完成这项工作。

paragraphs.en: With Kent at the helm, Washington Ballet has thrived. The number of sold tickets grew and so did the number of sponsors.
paragraphs.zh: 在肯特的领导下，华盛顿芭蕾舞团蓬勃发展。售出的门票数量增加了，赞助商的数量也增加了。

paragraphs.en: But despite her success, Kent doesn't like to compare Washington Ballet to other dance companies.
paragraphs.zh: 但尽管取得了成功，肯特并不喜欢将华盛顿芭蕾舞团与其他舞蹈团相提并论。
